I am honored to be endorsed by The Justice Coalition Action.

This political moment calls for bold leadership that is unafraid to speak out against the Israeli government’s genocide of the Palestinian people, take the necessary steps to end our complicity in atrocities overseas, and reshape U.S. policy through the lens of justice and dignity for all.

I'm proud to have their support as we fight for the liberation and self-determination of all people.
